title: DOWNED POSE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 3, the animation pass. A downed body used to be four flat blocks with a skin square at one end, the same for everyone. It is now a body lying on its side, head toward where it faced: boots, legs, hips, a chest that rises and falls with each breath, the head with its hair and a closed eye, and one arm reaching out for help. It wears its own coat, skin, hair and boots and keeps its BUILD, so Curved keeps her hips and chest down too, and the shoulder shows the team colour in a raid. Nothing about play changes.
now: Downed bodies lie on their side, breathing, one arm reaching out, in their own look and build.
